strategy.offer: Software, SaaS, web services, market data, analyses, outsourced operational services, consulting, and training for regulated energy-market processes.
strategy.customers: Energy companies, especially network operators, suppliers, balancing roles, and other organizations needing calculation, data management, compliance, and digitization support.
strategy.why_we_win: It claims integrated data, applications, and services simplify complex legal and operational tasks, improve data quality, and save customers time, risk, and follow-on costs.
strategy.resources: Its basis is long-built industry databases, analytical know-how, software development, an internal data center, certified information security, and staff expertise.
strategy.direction: It is moving toward a fuller digital platform model: more SaaS, modular process-based applications, standardized data exchange, and broader end-to-end service provision.
